messages:
Marta: Quick UX check — I'm finalizing the batch upload preview (CSV) copy and the empty-state voiceover. Two questions: 1) Do we need a tokenization hint under the sample? 2) How verbose should the screen reader announcement be on successful parse?

Sam: +1. For tokenization hint: keep it short. Maybe \"Token counts are approximate. We split on whitespace by default.\" Show it collapsed by default.

Jun: UX note: make token counts opt-in with a small checkbox: \"Show token counts\". For voiceover, prefer a concise announcement like \"3 rows imported, 12 tokens total.\"

Aisha: A11y: use aria-live=\"polite\" for parse success + aria-atomic so SRs read the full line. Add an accessible label on the file button like \"Change file (CSV or TSV)\" so it announces file type.

Marta: Good. CTA wording: currently \"Continue\" & \"Cancel\". Proposal: primary = \"Import rows\" (clearer), secondary = \"Back\". Empty-sample microcopy: \"Drop a CSV with one column of text, or paste rows below.\" Thoughts?

Sam: I like \"Import rows\". Also add tiny helper under file input: \"Preview shows up to 50 rows; max 10k rows per import.\" Keep that visually muted.

Jun: Keyboard flow: after parse, focus should move to the \"Show token counts\" toggle so keyboard users can opt in without tabbing through the table.

Aisha: Voiceover nuance: when preview renders and tokens are off, announce: \"Preview ready. 50 rows shown. Token counts available via Show token counts.\" If tokens are on, say: \"Preview ready. 50 rows shown. 432 tokens total.\" Short, consistent.

upload-bot: Parse report: rows=50, errors=0, tokens=432.

Marta: Proposed final sample block + microcopy (mock):

```
id,text
1,What's the refund policy?
2,Where can I find my API key?
3,How to export my vectors?
```

Microcopy under sample: \"Header row optional. We read the first column as text. Preview shows first 50 rows.\"

Sam: Minor: make \"Header row optional\" less ambiguous — maybe \"If present, first column header will be ignored\".

Aisha: Also add aria-describedby on the sample container referencing the helper text id so SR users can hear the limits and header note when the preview is focused.

Jun: For long cell content, show truncation with hover and SR text: \"Truncated — full text available on import\" and an inline \"… +215 more\" indicator. That avoids sudden layout shifts.

Marta: Will update mocks with: primary CTA \"Import rows\", helper copy, aria-live behavior, \"Show token counts\" toggle (off by default), and SR-friendly truncation text. Anyone object to wording?

Sam: LGTM :thumbsup:

Aisha: no objections, thanks!

Marta: I'll push an updated Figma and tag you all. Follow-up: should we include a tiny inline \"Why token counts?\" link that opens a tooltip with one sentence? (keeps main UI clean)

Jun: yes, tooltip is perfect. Keep it brief: \"Token counts approximate how the model will split text; used for cost estimation.\"

Marta: Perfect. I'll update and post the figma link here once done. Thanks everyone.
